Changelog

New features, improvements, and bug fixes. We ship fast.

v2.1.0 December 1, 2025 Latest

Major Dashboard Improvements

New Features
  • Added real-time collaboration features to the dashboard
  • Introduced command palette for quick navigation (Cmd+K)
  • New interactive metrics dashboard with live charts
  • Advanced file upload with drag-and-drop support
Improvements
  • Enhanced chat interface with better typing indicators
  • Improved pricing calculator with annual billing options
  • Faster page load times across all routes
Bug Fixes
  • Fixed theme toggle not persisting on page refresh
  • Resolved mobile navigation menu overflow issues
v2.0.0 November 15, 2025

Complete Platform Redesign

New Features
  • Brand new component library with 20+ reusable components
  • Dark mode support with system preference detection
  • Toast notification system
  • Cookie consent banner with granular controls
Improvements
  • Complete UI overhaul with modern design system
  • Improved accessibility across all components
  • Better mobile responsiveness
v1.5.0 October 28, 2025

Security & Performance Updates

New Features
  • Two-factor authentication support
  • API rate limiting dashboard
  • Webhook management interface
Improvements
  • 50% faster API response times
  • Enhanced security headers
  • Improved error messages and logging
Bug Fixes
  • Fixed memory leak in websocket connections
  • Resolved CORS issues for certain API endpoints
  • Fixed timezone display issues in analytics
v1.0.0 September 1, 2025

Initial Public Release 🎉

Our first public release! GenAI is now available to everyone. Thank you to our beta testers for all the valuable feedback.
